$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-route-distance-and-rdw-lookup D3). Seeds the DORMANT `rdw-open-data` source: the RDW open data (Socrata) API of registered vehicles, which needs no credential. A sibling app (humaniq people-register-prefill) declares a connection such as `rdw-voertuigen`; an administrator links it to this source, and the app then calls it through OCA\Integriq\Event\ConnectionCallRequestedEvent, for example GET /m9d7-ebf2.json?kenteken=GB123X for the vehicle with that plate (make `merk`, `handelsbenaming`, `datum_eerste_toelating`, `catalogusprijs`). Enable the source to use it.

objects.name: RDW open data
objects.description: The RDW register of vehicles in the Netherlands, as open data: make, first registration date and catalogue price by licence plate. No credential is needed. Link it to an app's vehicle connection and enable the source.
